mapper.select: SELECT id, feishu_chat_id, feishu_chat_type, feishu_sender_open_id, agent_id, session_id, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at FROM feishu_agent_session_binding WHERE feishu_chat_id = #{feishuChatId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feishu_agent_session_binding ( id, feishu_chat_id, feishu_chat_type, feishu_sender_open_id, agent_id, session_id, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{feishuChatId}, #{feishuChatType}, #{feishuSenderOpenId}, CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastMessageAt} )

INSERT INTO feishu_agent_session_binding ( id, feishu_chat_id, feishu_chat_type, feishu_sender_open_id, agent_id, session_id, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{feishuChatId}, #{feishuChatType}, #{feishuSenderOpenId}, CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastMessageAt} ) ON CONFLICT (feishu_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET feishu_chat_type = EXCLUDED.feishu_chat_type, feishu_sender_open_id = EXCLUDED.feishu_sender_open_id, agent_id = EXCLUDED.agent_id, session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at
